ads_link_instability.symptom: the ADS1115 dropped offline and came back repeatedly while the sealed zero was being probed. Raw p2p went from 2-8 counts to 158-3359 counts, and the true zero swung between -3.67 and +6.91 mmHg between 10 s windows. Each recovery landed on a different baseline (true -1.28 / +5.4 / +5.7).
ads_link_instability.firmware_path: ads1115.c:154-158 reads the conversion register and treats any successful HAL transfer as a good sample, ads1115.c:215-218 clamps a negative pressure to 0, and main.c:461 prints VALID whenever the calibration record is valid. A zero or stale conversion therefore reaches the host as a plausible reading.

ads_link_instability.error_code_notes: 0x00000200 is HAL_I2C_WRONG_START (START was requested but SB never set, stm32f1xx_hal_i2c.c:3577) and 0x00000020 is HAL_I2C_ERROR_TIMEOUT. Neither is an AF/NACK, so the slave did not refuse the address; the peripheral failed to get the START condition acknowledged at all.
ads_link_instability.resolution: it cleared between 11:26:43 and 11:31:03, and the clearing left a fingerprint: the fault went from code=4 SENSOR_READ to code=0 NONE, the ADSdiag counters went from errors=20 recoveries=19 to 0/0, and the raw baseline moved from sensor 306-308 mV (true +5.30..+5.47) to 226-229 mV (true -1.28..-1.03). ads1115.c never zeroes s_diag.error_count and only BP_Control_Reset (bp_control.c:68-79) can clear a latched fault, so an MCU restart is the most likely explanation. No reset banner was captured because the banner is only emitted to whatever client holds the socket, and the windows are opened one at a time; the gap 11:26:43-11:31:03 has no listener. After that: twelve consecutive 4 s windows and then eight 5 s windows clean, true -1.28..-1.03 with p2p 2-11, then -0.71..-0.54 with p2p 2-3.
ads_link_instability.impact_on_the_card: the 11:05 four-state probe and the 11:08 vent watch both fall inside this unstable window, so their absolute values (+3.66 / +9.75) are not trustworthy; the stable sealed zero -0.38 recorded above comes from the 11:14 seal watch, which was taken after the bus settled and held flat for 185 s.
